purpose: M0 sustained audio/UI load isolation before any M1 work

sequence.change_from_previous: Fresh worker-only baseline with no benchmark audio/UI child
Add independent silent PipeWire audio probe
Remove benchmark audio probe; retain UI

sleep_idle_inhibition: systemd-inhibit sleep:idle and live desktop ScreenSaver cookie in every trial; owned-PID KWin placement only if UIselected
native_execution: Frozen Vulkan runtime/model; blocking fence wait and child PASSIVE/zero-spin OpenMP
worker_execution: Same persistent worker, fixed repeated fixture/window grid, saturation, cancellation/seek checks and native/system sampler in everytrial

cooldown.on_timeout: Record condition notmatched; reportactualstarting thermal/RAM and avoidcausal attribution. No systemsettingchanges.

measurement_limits: Four separate sequential runs, one requested benchmark load factor toggled at each adjacent transition; fixed order and no replicate percondition.
Other desktop/audio stack processes remain present; no exclusive machine or GPU claim.
Different heat/memory/cache histories remain possible; do not attribute all differences to selected load.
No heavy traceanalysis, compression, tests or builds during active GPU measurements.
Absent probes are not_run with null metrics; no claim of zero audio faults or UIcoverage when disabled.
FullM0 qualification requires bothload fullcoverage, controls and latencytarget; noM1 advancement from an isolated condition.

series_level_inhibition.scope: Common systemd sleep:idle and live desktop ScreenSaver inhibition across all trials and remaining cooldowns; each trial retains its identical scoped wrappers. ScreenSaver.GetActive returnedfalse before acquisition.
